name: Frantic Math
author: Addicting Games
description: Frantic Math is a free educational game. Math is not a simple escapist past time, it is a complicated set of rules and expectations. Some of those rules are complex and boring and some are so simple and taught to us so early that they become second nature. When you're adding up sums to single and double-digit numbers you barely even know you're doing math. It's just so natural and so easy. In Frantic Math, you'll be asked to take full control of your elementary math skills in order to add your way to the goal. Frantic Math is a game that confronts you with a solution and your job is to slide the various smaller numbers together in order to replicate that solution. You must think and move fast in this game since more numbers are added to the queue every few seconds and eventually you'll be drowned in an avalanche of numbers. This game is just all about adding up adjacent numbers towards a pre-determined solution. That is it. That is all that is required of you! This is a fun and fascinating game bereft of the needless complexities and obstacles in everyday life.
